WeKan before 12.78 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in Exporter.buildStream() that lets attackers retrieve checklists from other boards by supplying a checklistId export scope. WeKan before 12.78 contains an access control bypass in Exporter.buildCsvStream() that ignores the Disable all export and Anonymize export users settings. Board readers or unauthenticated users of public boards can request the CSV export endpoint to export all cards and reveal real usernames in member, assignee, and mention fields.

plugNmeet-server before 2.5.3 contains an authorization flaw in PollsController.HandleUserSubmitResponse that allows authenticated room participants to submit poll votes as other users by supplying an arbitrary UserId.
